title: Live Music Fridays
description: Ignite your weekend with live sets from Johannesburg's finest bands, flame-grilled specials and a bar that never sleeps.

title: Jazz Nights
description: An intimate evening of smoky standards and smooth improvisation, paired with a curated three-course tasting menu.

title: Comedy Night
description: South Africa's sharpest comics take the Fusion Flame stage. Dinner, drinks and belly laughs — the perfect mid-week escape.

title: Cape Winelands Tasting
description: Our sommelier walks you through eight estate wines from Stellenbosch and Franschhoek, matched with fire-kissed canapés.

title: Steak Festival
description: A carnivore's dream: dry-aged cuts, rare breeds and open-flame masterclasses from Chef Laurent and his brigade.

title: Valentine's Dinner
description: A candle-lit five-course affair with champagne on arrival, live strings and a rose for every table.
dressCode: Formal, with a touch of red

title: Christmas Dinner
description: Celebrate the season in golden style — a festive feast of flame-roasted gammon, glazed duck and decadent desserts.

title: New Year's Gala
description: Ring in the new year with a black-tie gala: seven courses, free-flowing bubbly, live band and a midnight fire show.
